scenes.basis: 16:1-8 the tomb scene - "the tomb" (15:46) has no id of its own and is not placed by name
16:9-11 the appearance to Mary Magdalene - no place named
16:12-13 "to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country" - the road is not named
16:14-18 "he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table" - no place named
16:19-20 "he was received up into heaven" - no earthly place named
